title: Admission Procedure & Steps
answer:
📝 **Admission Procedure at RVPU Mysore**:

1. Obtain application form from campus / admissions office post-SSLC result announcement.
2. Submit application with 4 passport-size photographs & attested copy of Class 10 marksheet.
3. Cut-off percentage determination & Merit List announcement.
4. Enrollment finalized on merit / first-come, first-served basis as per the cutoff list.

💡 **Tips**: Admissions commence immediately following the declaration of Class 10 / SSLC board exam results. We advise applying early as seats are allotted on merit and first-come, first-served basis.

title: Required Documents for Admission
answer:
📄 **Documents Required for Admission at RVPU Mysore**:

• SSLC / Class 10 Marks Card (Original + Xerox copies)
• Aadhaar Card copy
• Transfer Certificate (TC) from previous institution
• Conduct Certificate from previous institution
• Provisional Eligibility Certificate (for non-Karnataka/international candidates)
• Caste / Category Certificate (for SC/ST/BCM candidates)
• Income Certificate (if family income below ₹44,500/year)

*Note*: Ensure you bring the original certificates along with at least 3 attested photocopies for verification during counseling.

title: Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria
answer:
🎯 **Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria**:

• **Eligibility**: Candidates who have successfully cleared SSLC / ICSE / CBSE / 10th Standard or equivalent board.
• **Cutoff Announcement**: Cutoffs are finalized upon declaration of 10th board results and displayed on the college notice board & website.
• **Promotion Criteria (I PUC to II PUC)**: Minimum 30% marks in each individual subject and 35% overall aggregate in district-level promotional exams.
